dedupe_keys.name: saveecobot water quality map of ukraine official monitoring of the state agency of water resources

description: SaveEcoBot is a Ukrainian civic environmental platform that maps official and sensor data on the state of the environment, and its water map shows the quality of water in Ukraine's rivers, lakes and reservoirs. The page read on 2026-09-28 says the map displays up-to-date results of the official water monitoring of the State Agency of Water Resources of Ukraine, highlighting exceedances of standards, next to the platform's maps of air quality, background radiation and fires; its listed data sources include the State Agency of Water Resources, the Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center, NASA FIRMS, NOAA, the Institute for the Study of War and OpenStreetMap, and it notes that data are published without verification. Coverage is Ukraine. Access is free in the browser; no licence or download is stated. Caveats: SaveEcoBot is not the data owner, readings appear as delivered, and monitoring gaps follow the war. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response studies of drinking water sources in Ukraine, such as pollution after attacks on dams and treatment plants. No related Ukrainian water quality record is catalogued.
